units.source_text: 到了三月里，六条院庭中紫藤花与棣棠花盛开。

en.t: By the third month, wisteria and yellow kerria were in full bloom in the gardens of the Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 有一天薄暮，源氏看了庭花，立刻想起那美人儿住在这邸内时的情状，

en.t: One evening at dusk, Genji looked at the flowers in the garden and at once remembered how that beautiful lady had been when she lived in this residence,

units.source_text: 便走出紫姬所居的春殿，来到以前玉鬘所居的西厅。

en.t: so he left the Spring Palace where Lady Murasaki lived and went to the western wing where Tamakazura had once stayed.

units.source_text: 但见庭中细竹编成的篱垣上，象征玉鬘的棣棠花参参差差地开着，

en.t: There he saw, on the fence woven from slender bamboo in the garden, the yellow kerria that symbolized Tamakazura blooming here and there in uneven clusters,
and the scene was extraordinarily graceful.

units.source_text: 源氏信口吟唱“但将身上衣，染成栀子色”的古歌，

en.t: Genji casually sang an old poem, "I would only dye the robe I wear the color of gardenia,"
and then composed a poem of his own:
